objective: Test the locked clustered-minus-shuffled effect across three populations, two grid resolutions and an independent correlated-random-field holdout family without treating repeated scales as independent seeds.

data_checksums.generated_inputs: SHA-256 values are written by the committed generator to workspace/matched_input_audit.json before execution
data_checksums.dependency_calibration: After E0 passes, bind the SHA-256 of tracked research/jobs/E0-NUMERICS/numerical_calibration.json before execution

failure_policy: A scale-specific failure remains evidence against robustness. No population, resolution or landscape family may be replaced after outcomes are observed; a valid null result is not a job failure.
